1947 is not a leap year (1947 % 4 = 3).  
126 days before May 29, 1947:  
April has 30 days, so back to April 29 is 30 days (May 29 → April 29).  
Remaining 126 - 30 = 96 days earlier.  
March has 31 days → back to March 29 is 31 more days (96 - 31 = 65 left).  
February has 28 days → back to February 28 (not 29) is 28 more days (65 - 28 = 37 left).  
January has 31 days → back to January 28 is 31 days (37 - 31 = 6 left).  
December 1946 has 31 days → December 28 + 6 days earlier = December 22, 1946.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1946-12-22
